integrity_notes: The complete intersection, nilradical, duality and multiplicity statements are established by an algebraic proof; finite computer checks are corroborative, not replacements for quantification over arbitrary characteristic.
scientific_limitations: Only the local Fano scheme at the vertex line of the specified rank-three quadric is classified. Existence and equations of K3 carpets are established prior mathematics; the proposed addition is their precise incidence as a Fano tangent cone, and its local multiplicity. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: A canonical K3 carpet as the Fano-vertex tangent cone of a rank-three quadric
